title: Validity of Encoded Circuit Inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a family of finite acyclic Boolean circuits, and let $\tau$ be a size, gate-type, or edge task. Every word in the language associated with $C$ and $\tau$ is a valid input for that task: it has the required unary and canonical binary encoding, including the two canonical binary components required for an edge query.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a family of DAG circuits
$x$ belongs to the language associated with $C$ and $\tau$
